_comment: Governed planning assumptions. None of these values exist in the Bayer builder data pack; they are explicit, documented and adjustable. Every result records the version and hash of the file it was computed with.

lead_time_weeks._comment: Total replenishment lead time = release & dispatch from the supply source's finished-goods stock (QA release, picking, documentation) + transport (by primary mode). Manufacturing time is NOT included: the data pack has no production capacity or batch data.

reliability._comment: Late deliveries extend effective lead time: LT_eff = LT + (1 - OTIF) * late_delivery_penalty_weeks.

safety_stock._comment: Safety stock is driven by forecast error (from forecast accuracy), not by raw shipment volatility.
